articles.title: Best Mattress in UAE 2026: 10 Questions to Ask Before You Buy
articles.body:
Best Mattress in UAE 2026: 10 Questions to Ask Before You Buy

Last updated: September 2026 · Written by the MAYF Home Sleep Team

Choosing the best mattress in the UAE isn't simply about finding the softest, firmest or most expensive option.

The right mattress depends on how you sleep, the firmness you prefer, your body weight, whether you sleep hot, whether you share your bed and your budget.

This guide answers 10 of the most important questions to ask before buying a mattress in the UAE — so you can narrow down your options with confidence.

Quick Answer: What Is the Best Mattress in the UAE?

There is no single best mattress for everyone. The right choice depends on your sleeping position, firmness preference, body weight, temperature preferences and budget.

Side sleeper?
Many side sleepers prefer a medium feel that provides cushioning around the shoulders and hips.

Back sleeper?
Many back sleepers consider medium-firm mattresses, although comfort remains personal.

Sleep hot?
Pocket spring cores, latex and gel-infused foam commonly allow more airflow than dense traditional memory foam.

Budget of AED 1,200–1,800?
This range can cover a pocket spring mattress with a gel or latex comfort layer. At MAYF, the medium-firm Cool Fusion Gel Tight Top starts from AED 1,170.

Want a hotel-style bed?
Look for a pocket spring mattress with a plush pillow top or Euro top, such as the MAYF Signature Hotel Collection Mattress.

Want time to test your mattress?
MAYF mattresses include a 100-night sleep trial, 10-year warranty and free UAE delivery.

Not sure where to start?

Take the 60-second MAYF Mattress Finder →

Before You Buy: Start With These 10 Questions

  1. What makes a mattress right for me?

  2. What firmness should I choose?

  3. Pocket spring, memory foam or latex?

  4. What should I choose if I sleep hot?

  5. How can I reduce partner disturbance?

  6. How much should I spend?

  7. How do I create a hotel-style sleep experience?

  8. Can I try the mattress at home?

  9. What mattress size do I need?

  10. What else should I check before ordering?

1. What Makes a Mattress “the Best” for You?

The best mattress is the one that fits your body, sleeping habits and comfort preferences.

Before comparing brands or prices, consider these factors:

Factor Ask Yourself
Sleeping position How do I normally fall asleep and wake up?
Firmness Do I prefer cushioning or a firmer surface?
Body weight & support Does the support core suit my build?
Temperature Do I regularly wake up feeling hot?
Partner movement Does movement from my partner disturb me?
Construction Do I prefer bounce, contouring or responsiveness?
Trial & warranty Can I properly test the mattress at home?
Budget What can I comfortably spend?
Mattress size What are my bed frame's exact internal dimensions?
Bed base Is my existing base flat and supportive?

Once you've answered these questions, you can usually narrow a large mattress range down to a much more manageable shortlist.

The MAYF Mattress Finder is designed to help you do that in around a minute.

TRY THE MATTRESS FINDER →

2. What Mattress Firmness Should I Choose?

Firmness describes how a mattress feels, not simply how supportive it is.

Use the following as a starting point:

Firmness Typical Feel Often Considered By
Soft More sink and cushioning Side sleepers wanting more pressure relief
Medium Balanced cushioning and support Many side and combination sleepers
Medium-firm More support with moderate cushioning Many back sleepers and people preferring less sink
Firm Minimal sink and firmer surface People who specifically prefer a firm feel

Important: Firmness Is Personal

Firmness scales vary between manufacturers.

MAYF rates mattress firmness out of 10, with a higher number indicating a firmer feel.

MAYF Mattress Firmness From
Cool Fusion Gel Tight Top 7/10 — Medium-firm AED 1,170
Signature Hotel Collection Medium-firm + pillow top AED 2,799
Hotel Collection Euro Top 8/10 AED 750
Nature's Haven Latex Tight Top 8/10 — Firm AED 1,125
Hotel Collection Tight Top 9/10 — Firm AED 600

No sleeping position guarantees that a particular firmness will suit you.

Use sleeping position and firmness to create your shortlist, then use a home trial to determine whether the mattress actually suits you.

3. Pocket Spring, Memory Foam or Latex: Which Should I Choose?

Different mattress constructions produce different sleeping sensations.

Pocket Spring

Feel: Responsive support with some bounce

Individually wrapped springs can provide support while allowing more space for airflow than a solid foam block.

Often considered by: Couples and sleepers who prefer an “on top of the mattress” feeling.

Check: Spring count, zoning and how the springs are encased.

Gel Memory Foam

Feel: Contouring and pressure-relieving

Foam creates more of a hugging sensation around the body.

Gel infusion is designed to help reduce some of the warmth associated with traditional dense memory foam.

Often considered by: People who prefer contouring and cushioning.

Latex

Feel: Buoyant and responsive

Latex generally responds more quickly than memory foam and creates a springier sensation.

Often considered by: People who prefer natural materials and a more responsive sleep surface.

Many MAYF mattresses combine a pocket spring support core with gel, foam or latex comfort layers.

4. I Sleep Hot. What Should I Look For in the UAE?

Even with air conditioning running, the materials surrounding your body can influence how warm your sleep environment feels.

When comparing mattresses, consider:

  • A pocket spring core that leaves more room for air movement than a solid foam block

  • Gel-infused or latex comfort layers

  • A breathable mattress cover

  • Breathable sheets and bedding

At MAYF, the Cool Fusion Gel Tight Top starts from AED 1,170, while the Cool Fusion Gel Euro Top starts from AED 1,395.

Both combine gel-infused memory foam with pocket springs.

For shoppers who prefer natural materials, the Nature's Haven Latex Tight Top combines natural Dunlop latex with a linen-cotton cover.

EXPLORE COOLING MATTRESSES →

5. I Share My Mattress. How Can I Reduce Partner Disturbance?

When two people share a bed, movement and available sleeping space become especially important.

Individually wrapped pocket springs move independently, which can help reduce how much movement travels across the mattress when your partner changes position.

Size matters too.

If you frequently disturb one another during sleep, moving to a King or Super King can give each person more room.

The MAYF Couples Bedroom Collection brings together mattresses and bedding selected for two.

EXPLORE THE COUPLES COLLECTION →

6. How Much Should I Spend on a Mattress in the UAE?

You don't necessarily need to buy the most expensive mattress to find one that suits you.

Here's how the MAYF range breaks down by starting price:

Budget MAYF Options
Under AED 1,000 Hotel Collection Tight Top from AED 600 · Hotel Collection Euro Top from AED 750
AED 1,000–1,800 Nature's Haven Latex Tight Top from AED 1,125 · Cool Fusion Gel Tight Top from AED 1,170 · Nature's Haven Latex Euro Top from AED 1,350 · Cool Fusion Gel Euro Top from AED 1,395
AED 1,800+ MAYF Latex Natural from AED 1,899 · Signature Hotel Collection from AED 2,799

Looking for medium-firm around AED 1,200–1,800?

The closest MAYF match in this guide is the Cool Fusion Gel Tight Top, rated 7/10 medium-firm and starting from AED 1,170.

When comparing mattresses from any supplier, look beyond the soft top layer.

Ask about:

Support core · Spring construction · Comfort layers · Trial · Warranty

MAYF purchases can also be split into four payments using Tabby or Tamara.

7. Where Can I Find a Hotel-Style Mattress?

A hotel-style bed isn't created by softness alone.

The familiar luxury-hotel feeling usually comes from several layers working together:

  • Pocket spring support

  • Plush pillow top or Euro top

  • Good mattress height

  • Reinforced edges

  • Supportive pillows

  • Quality sheets and duvet

MAYF Signature Hotel Collection

The MAYF Signature Hotel Collection Mattress is the contract-grade mattress MAYF makes for hotels and sells directly to customers.

It features:

  • 7-zone pocket spring system

  • Pillow top

  • Reinforced edges

  • 34 cm profile

  • Medium-firm feel

  • Starting from AED 2,799

For a lower budget, the Hotel Collection Euro Top starts from AED 750, while the Hotel Collection Tight Top starts from AED 600.

EXPLORE HOTEL-STYLE MATTRESSES →

8. Can I Try a Mattress Before Committing?

A few minutes lying on a mattress doesn't necessarily tell you how you'll feel after sleeping on it for several weeks.

That's why MAYF mattresses include a 100-night sleep trial at home.

How the MAYF Sleep Trial Works

Nights 1–21
Allow your body time to adjust to the mattress.

Nights 21–100
If the mattress isn't right, MAYF can collect it and either refund it or exchange it once for a different model or firmness.

Collection
A flat AED 250 collection charge covers delivery and is deducted from the refund.

Restocking
There is no restocking fee.

Important: Use a mattress protector from the first night. The mattress needs to remain clean and undamaged to qualify for return.

Read the complete conditions on the MAYF Returns & Refunds page.

9. What Mattress Size Do I Need in the UAE?

Before ordering a mattress, measure the inside of your bed frame, rather than relying only on names such as Queen or King.

MAYF mattresses are available in sizes including:

Mattress Size
90 × 200 cm
120 × 200 cm
150 × 200 cm
160 × 200 cm
180 × 200 cm
200 × 200 cm

Availability varies by mattress model.

Have a non-standard bed frame?

Send your measurements to MAYF on WhatsApp.

Custom-length items are made specifically for your bed and cannot be returned under the standard sleep trial.

10. What Else Should I Check Before Buying?

Before placing your order, check these five things.

Warranty

MAYF mattresses carry a 10-year warranty covering manufacturing faults.

Delivery

Delivery is free across the UAE.

Inspect your mattress when it arrives and report any damage within 48 hours.

Bed Base Compatibility

MAYF mattresses require a flat, supportive surface, including:

  • Slatted base

  • Platform bed

  • Divan

Need a new frame? Explore the MAYF Beds Collection.

Mattress Care

Rotate your mattress head to foot every three months.

Do not flip it because the comfort layers are constructed to face one direction.

Payment

MAYF also offers the option to split purchases into four instalments using Tabby or Tamara.

Frequently Asked Questions

What's the best mattress in the UAE?

There is no single best mattress for everyone. The right mattress depends on your sleeping position, firmness preference, body weight, whether you sleep hot and your budget. A home sleep trial can help you confirm whether your choice suits you.

What firmness is best for side sleepers?

Many side sleepers prefer a medium feel that allows the shoulders and hips to sink in slightly, but comfort is personal. Use sleeping position as a starting point and confirm your choice with a home trial.

What type of mattress is best for hot sleepers in the UAE?

Pocket spring cores, latex and gel-infused foam commonly allow more airflow than dense traditional memory foam. Breathable covers and bedding can also influence how warm you sleep.

How much does a good mattress cost in the UAE?

At MAYF Home, pocket spring mattresses start from AED 600, while models with gel or latex comfort layers start from AED 1,125. Prices vary by size and model.

Can I return a MAYF mattress?

MAYF mattresses include a 100-night sleep trial. According to the terms in this guide, after 21 nights and up to night 100, MAYF can collect the mattress and either refund it or exchange it once. An AED 250 collection charge applies.

Do MAYF mattresses come with a warranty?

MAYF mattresses carry a 10-year warranty covering manufacturing faults, with free UAE delivery and the option to pay in four instalments using Tabby or Tamara.

Ready to Find Your Mattress?

If you've worked through these 10 questions, you should now have a much clearer idea of the mattress construction, firmness, size and budget that suit your needs.

Find Your Match in 60 Seconds

Take the MAYF Mattress Finder for a personalised shortlist.

Whatever you choose, you'll have 100 nights at home to make sure it's right for you.

BROWSE ALL MATTRESSES →

About This Guide

This guide was written by the MAYF Home Sleep Team and reviewed by Mohammed Yousuff, Founder and Managing Director of MAYF Group, who has more than 13 years of experience in GCC retail and e-commerce.

articles.title: Where to Buy Custom Curtains in Dubai: A Practical Guide to Style, Price and Installation
articles.body:
Layered curtains bring soft daylight and flexible privacy to a contemporary bedroom. Illustrative image.

Finding curtains in Dubai is easy. Finding the right fabric, length, light control and installation for your particular windows takes a little more thought. Whether you are furnishing a new apartment, refreshing a bedroom or covering a wide villa window, this guide answers the questions shoppers often ask before buying.

If visiting several shops feels overwhelming, start with three decisions: which rooms need darkness, which need filtered daylight, and which windows are unusual in size. You can then compare complete quotes with a clearer idea of what each room needs.

If you already know your preferred style, explore MAYF Home's made-to-measure curtains and blinds. If you need help deciding, start with the room and the amount of daylight you want to keep.

Where is the best place to buy curtains in Dubai?

The best place depends on whether standard sizes fit your window. Ready-made curtains can work for a simple window when the dimensions and finish suit your room. For unusually tall, wide or recessed windows, a made-to-measure service lets you choose the fabric and style around the actual opening. Compare the full quote, including fabric, tracks or rods, measurement, delivery and fitting, rather than comparing fabric prices alone.

MAYF Home offers custom curtains and blinds across the UAE, with a free in-home measurement visit and professional installation. You can see fabric samples in your own room before confirming the final quote.

Is Dragon Mart cheaper than a made-to-measure service?

It can be a useful place to compare fabrics and prices, but a low fabric or panel price does not tell you the installed total. Ask each seller to specify fabric, lining, finished width and drop, fullness, track or rod, measurement, delivery, fitting and any motorization. A ready-made option may be the best value for a standard window; a made-to-measure quote is easier to judge when the whole job is itemized. MAYF Home's estimator includes measurement, delivery, rods and installation in its estimate, with the final quote confirmed on-site.

Are custom curtains worth it?

Custom curtains are particularly useful when ready-made panels leave gaps, sit at an awkward height or do not span the full window. They also allow you to coordinate the heading, fabric, lining and hardware. For a bedroom, getting the coverage right can matter as much as choosing the colour: light may enter at the sides or above an otherwise opaque curtain.

You do not have to judge the colour and texture from a screen alone. At MAYF Home's free visit, a curtain expert measures your windows and shows fabric samples in the room's own light. Check the samples in daylight and under your evening lights, and ask how the chosen fabric will hang at the proposed fullness.

For a straightforward, standard-size window, ready-made panels may be enough. Decide where you want a tailored finish and where a simpler treatment makes sense.

Which curtain style should I choose?

Room or need Consider Why
Living room with daylight Sheer curtains Soften daylight while keeping an airy look; they offer limited night-time privacy.
Bedroom where darkness matters Blackout curtains Reduce incoming light when the fabric and fit are chosen appropriately.
Flexible daytime and night-time control Sheer plus blackout layers Use sheers by day and close the outer layer for privacy and lower light.
Compact or practical window Roller blinds A neat treatment with a small visual footprint.
Decorative, structured finish Roman blinds Fabric folds give a softer, tailored look.
Tall or hard-to-reach window Motorized curtains Make frequent opening and closing easier.

For kitchens or bathrooms, consider moisture, cleaning and window access before choosing a fabric treatment. For a bedroom, prioritise privacy and light control; for a living room, decide whether you want a soft filtered view, full privacy after dark, or both. A sheer layer alone may become see-through when the interior is lit at night.

Browse MAYF Home's curtain collection for sheer, blackout, motorized, roller and Roman options. For a large opening, ask about track layout and panel joins before ordering.

Sheers soften daylight; the outer curtain adds privacy when closed. Illustrative image.

How much do curtains cost in Dubai?

The total depends on window dimensions, fabric, fullness, lining, track or rod choice and motorization. A listing's “from” price is a starting point, not a quote for every window. MAYF Home's current collection lists sheer curtains from AED 179, blackout curtains from AED 249, roller blinds from AED 149 and Roman blinds from AED 229; options and final dimensions can change the total. Check the live product page for current pricing.

For a closer estimate, use the online curtain price estimator. It lets you enter width and height and compare sheers, blackout, layered curtains and blinds. A home visit confirms the final measurements and quote.

Before paying a deposit, ask for: the final fabric and colour, lining or opacity, finished dimensions, number of panels, heading style, hardware, installation date and total installed price in writing. This makes two quotes easier to compare and reduces surprises during fitting.

How do I measure curtains so they look right?

Measure the area the finished curtain will cover, rather than relying only on the glass size. Note the intended track position, the finished drop and any skirting, furniture, air-conditioning units or door clearance. A higher track and wider coverage can make a window feel more generous and help reduce visible gaps.

Choose the hem deliberately: panels may stop just above the floor for easy cleaning, touch the floor for a tailored appearance, or pool slightly for a relaxed decorative effect. Before ordering, confirm the finished drop and whether the width quoted refers to the opening, track or fabric. For made-to-measure curtains, a professional site measurement helps settle these details.

What happens from the home visit to installation?

MAYF Home describes a free, no-obligation visit to measure your windows, show fabric samples and provide an exact quote. Once you select the fabric, colour and pleat style, its curtain service advertises tailored delivery and professional installation in 4–5 days. Confirm the actual production and fitting date for your address and order before paying, especially for large windows or motorized work. The site says rods and installation are included in its curtain pricing. Book a free curtain visit.

When the fitters finish, open and close each panel or blind, inspect the hem and joins, and check that the track operates smoothly. Raise any visible problem with the team before they leave.

What is a good affordable curtain choice for a Dubai apartment?

Prioritise the rooms where light and privacy affect daily life. A bedroom may benefit from blackout coverage; a living room may suit sheers or a layered solution. Neutral ivory, warm beige and soft taupe can sit comfortably with many contemporary UAE interiors. Ask for a written quote that shows the fabric choice, measurements, hardware and fitting so you can compare the overall value.

Frequently asked questions

Can I buy sheers, blackout curtains and Roman blinds from one provider?

Yes. MAYF Home's curtains and blinds collection includes these styles, alongside roller blinds and motorized options. A coordinated order can make colour, hardware and installation decisions simpler.

Do blackout curtains block all light?

Blackout fabric is designed to reduce light, but the result also depends on fit and installation. Light can still enter around edges, below a short panel or through a gap above the track. Discuss coverage and track placement if a dark bedroom is your priority.

Can curtains cover a 6 m, 8 m or wider window?

Wide openings need a considered track and panel plan. MAYF Home lists a large-window curtain option; request a site measurement to confirm the fabric, joins, operation and installation details for your opening.

Is home measurement available in the UAE?

MAYF Home advertises free in-home measurement and professional installation across the UAE. During the free visit, an expert can measure, show fabric samples and provide an exact quote. Confirm your location and timeline when booking.

Can I choose curtain fabric without relying on online photos?

Yes. MAYF Home says its expert brings fabric samples to the free home consultation, where you can see the colours and feel the material before choosing. Compare samples against your walls, flooring and furniture in the room where the curtains will hang.

Can I plan curtains for several rooms in one visit?

Ask the consultant to measure and quote every relevant window during your appointment. Note the requirements room by room so bedrooms, living areas and practical spaces receive suitable treatments. Confirm the scope, schedule and any package pricing in your written quote; a whole-home discount is not advertised as a standard offer.

What if my made-to-measure curtains arrive damaged or incorrectly supplied?

Inspect the installed order and report visible damage promptly. MAYF Home's returns policy asks customers to report visible damage within 48 hours with photographs and says faulty or incorrectly supplied items are repaired, replaced or refunded without a collection charge. Made-to-order and custom-size items are excluded from ordinary change-of-mind returns, and the 100-night sleep trial is for mattresses. Confirm any fit correction with the team in writing.

Choose curtains with confidence

Start with what the room needs: daylight, privacy, a darker bedroom or easy operation for a large window. Then compare fabric, dimensions and the complete installed price. Explore custom curtains and blinds at MAYF Home, try the price estimator, or book a free measurement visit.
